stages.name: Benchmark input
stages.input: Official Hypersim RGB, metric depth, cameras, and instance boxes
stages.operation: Select 50 evenly spaced views; transform cameras and visible GT into one metric raw-splat frame
stages.output: 50 RGB-D camera records, initialized points, visible GT, and three saved GT overlays
stages.missing: Only three prepared frames have pre-rendered GT overlay PNGs; all 50 RGB and depth frames are available

stages.name: Train 3D Gaussian
stages.input: 45 prepared RGB views, exact cameras, and initialized points
stages.operation: Optimize gsplat v1.5.3 for 5,000 steps without normalizing world space
stages.output: Full Gaussian PLY plus a training receipt
stages.missing: The trainer did not save a per-step visual timeline

stages.name: Hold-out verification
stages.input: Trained PLY and five reserved source cameras
stages.operation: Render the PLY at cameras excluded from optimization and calculate PSNR
stages.output: Five render PNGs, five GT/render comparison PNGs, and reconstruction metrics
stages.missing: PSNR does not explain discovery behavior at analyzer-generated cameras

stages.name: Standpoints + sweep
stages.operation: Density-sample five standpoints; render 6 azimuths × 3 elevations at 130° FOV from each
stages.output: 90 RGB PNGs, 90 depth PNGs, 90 raw depth arrays, poses, intrinsics, positions, and look targets
stages.missing: No saved score stating whether each sampled standpoint is inside useful room space

stages.name: OWLv2 detect + vote
stages.input: 90 analyzer RGB renders and the frozen seven-label vocabulary
stages.operation: Run OWLv2 at threshold 0.12; lift box centers through depth; cluster per label with one-vote support
stages.output: Post-cluster objects plus supporting 2D boxes in interactions.json
stages.missing: Raw OWLv2 scores, pre-cluster detections, and rejection logs were not saved

stages.name: Rectangular lift
stages.input: Post-cluster analyzer objects and their supporting 2D rectangles
stages.operation: Use center-patch depth for position; derive width/height from pixels and fabricate depth extent as (width+height)/2
stages.output: Axis-aligned native proposal boxes in benchmark JSONL
stages.missing: This output contains no dense object mask or volumetric support

stages.name: SAM mask lift
stages.input: The same saved analyzer boxes, paired RGB/depth, and camera matrices
stages.operation: Prompt SAM with each box; unproject valid mask pixels; depth-cluster and robustly fuse bounds
stages.output: Every saved binary SAM mask, per-view lift metadata, global 3D boxes, and receipt
stages.missing: Dining has no masks because discovery supplied no boxes to prompt SAM

stages.name: Active SliceVote
stages.input: Global SAM proposal boxes, founding masks, full PLY, shell, and camera sidecars
stages.operation: Render fitted plan and object-centered tunnel/cardinal views; detect, cast mask-cone votes, apply gates and fallbacks
stages.output: All saved plan/tunnel/vote/detection PNGs, per-object conemaps, report, and shipping boxes
stages.missing: Dining has no active evidence because it has no proposal identities

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.input: Visible Hypersim GT and each method's benchmark-schema boxes
stages.operation: Exact-label 3D IoU matching; scene-macro AP/recall; paired diagnostics and bootstrap summary
stages.output: Per-scene metrics, per-class values, pooled metrics, and input hashes
stages.missing: Metrics reveal where output differs from GT but do not diagnose upstream rendering or detection

stages.name: External baselines
stages.input: Boxer: 50 posed RGB-D frames. Zoo3D: posed frames plus 200k metric points
stages.operation: Run each released proposal path; adapt native 3D output to the common AABB evaluator
stages.output: 50 Zoo3D input/mask pairs, all Boxer 2D boxes, both 3D prediction sets, and common metrics
stages.missing: These are cross-system references, not fixed-proposal causal ablations
